## vMLX 1.6.26 for macOS

Built from source commit `980ec812f`.

### Highlights

- Health polling no longer stalls generation. While a model is generating, the health endpoint returns the last idle-time snapshot with live status and queue overlays instead of rebuilding its full diagnostics on every poll — removing a 330–410 ms pause per poll from the decode thread. Because that handler is model-agnostic, sustained decoding is smoother for every family (Qwen, Ornith and Bonsai bases, Gemma, MiniMax, Laguna, Step, DeepSeek V4 Flash).
- DeepSeek V4 Flash long-context, long-output decoding is smooth. The extended-store KV delta chain now batches its per-256-token snapshot into a single asynchronous materialization instead of a few hundred blocking evaluations on the decode thread — a 15k-context, 2,048-token generation is now stall-free in every window, with cross-turn cache reuse unchanged and verified.

Separate signed and Apple-notarized Apple-silicon downloads are available for macOS Tahoe and Sequoia-compatible systems. Tahoe is the default download.
